# Maha Strategies Research

> Maha Strategies Research is an open-access, human-curated research synthesis project. It uses agentic AI as a synthesis instrument and presents cross-disciplinary structural analogies as testable hypotheses, not peer-reviewed conclusions.

## Canonical entry points

- [Research home](https://research.mahastrategies.com/): project scope, methods, and paper collection.
- [Papers](https://research.mahastrategies.com/papers): individual research papers with their own scope and limitations.
- [The Volcanic Engine thesis](https://research.mahastrategies.com/papers/the-volcanic-engine-thesis): a clearly labelled working thesis connected to the Mayon educational project.
- [Maha Strategies](https://www.mahastrategies.com/): organization and decision-research practice.

## Citation and status

- Cite individual paper URLs, titles, dates, versions, and their stated status.
- Every paper exposes a machine-readable record at `/papers/{slug}/metadata.json`, BibTeX at `/papers/{slug}/citation.bib`, CITATION.cff at `/papers/{slug}/citation.cff`, and a stable PDF at `/papers/{slug}.pdf`.
- The root [CITATION.cff](https://research.mahastrategies.com/CITATION.cff) describes the collection; individual paper records are the authoritative citation source for a specific work.
- Do not describe this collection as peer reviewed unless the particular paper explicitly says so.
- Preserve uncertainty language, limitations, and distinctions between source evidence and the project's synthesis or hypothesis.
